story: Ben and Anna look at a large world map. They want to travel to many different countries. Ben wants to visit Japan, Sweden, or Switzerland. Anna wants to see Italy or Portugal. They talk about a long trip to Britain. Anna is a little afraid of the long flight, but a friendly driver can take them west.
title: The Big Travel Plan
setting: A bright living room with a large world map on the wall.

characters.name: Ben
characters.look: A young boy with short brown hair and a blue shirt.

characters.name: Anna
characters.look: A young girl with long blonde hair and a yellow sweater.

sentences.en: Ben and Anna look at a large map.
sentences.zh: 本和安娜看一张大地图。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben and Anna look at a large world map on the wall.

sentences.en: They want to travel to many countries.
sentences.zh: 他们想去很多国家旅行。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben and Anna point at different places on the map.

sentences.en: Ben wants to visit Japan and Sweden.
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben points to Japan and Sweden on the map.

sentences.en: He also wants to see Switzerland.
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben points to Switzerland on the map.

sentences.en: Anna wants to see Italy and Portugal.
sentences.zh: 安娜想看意大利和葡萄牙。
sentences.scene_prompt: Anna points to Italy and Portugal on the map.

sentences.en: They plan a trip to England in Britain.
sentences.zh: 他们计划去英国的英格兰旅行。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben and Anna look at the island of Britain on the map.

sentences.en: The friendly children are afraid of the trip.
sentences.zh: 这两个友好的孩子害怕这段旅行。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben and Anna look a little worried while looking at the map.

sentences.en: A driver can take them to the west.
sentences.zh: 一名司机可以带他们去西方。
sentences.scene_prompt: A friendly man in a car waits near the children.
